title: Design: Lines table headings keep their place when the Credit Hold banner shows
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for, on the COD credit term.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer, on the COD credit term, so the payer can be put on Credit Hold during the case.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Complete, ready to invoice, billed to customer B, with one labor line, so the lines table shows.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-13-before-lines.png, bt-p3-14-after-banner.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Take a screenshot of the page.
  3. Open customer B's Edit Customer window.
  4. Choose Credit Hold in Credit Terms.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A with no Credit Hold banner.

Step 2:

  • You have a picture of where each heading, field and button sits before the change.

Step 3:

  • Customer B's Edit Customer window opens.

Step 4:

  • Credit Terms reads Credit Hold.

Step 5:

  • The window closes.

Step 6:

  • The Credit Hold banner reads "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [customer B's name], is on Credit Hold", with "Change Bill To".
  • Every lines-table heading is in the same left-right place as in your screenshot: the table only moves down by the banner's height.
  • The work order's tabs are in the same place as in your screenshot.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12309 (Story 7, Invoicing to the Bill To)

  • S7-R6: “If the Bill To is on Credit Hold, the Credit Hold banner reads M2 with a "Change Bill To" button (work orders: page header; part sales: Finance tab).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “M2 | Create Invoice when the Bill To is on Credit Hold | "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, [Bill To], is on Credit Hold" | Banner with "Change Bill To"; Create Invoice tooltip; error toast with "Change Bill To"”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794510417-a68d (its boards are byte-identical to version 1794239066-4906 read 9 Nov 2026), read 13 Nov 2026: pictures "Lines" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", Production (v26.45.2.1)), "Banner" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-13-before-lines.png
  • bt-p3-14-after-banner.png

The design's own words:

  • “Production checks only Buda, which is on COD, so no banner.”
  • “Banner: "Cannot invoice. The Bill To customer, Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair, is on Credit Hold", with "Change Bill To".”

The design's before and after pictures (compared 13 Nov 2026) keep all 8 lines-table headings at the same left-right place; the table drops by the banner's height.
